title: Build a clear paragraph · recall sheet
source: Original writing exercise; a useful scaffold, not a universal writing rule.
copy:
Exact title: "Build a clear paragraph". Subtitle: "Recall it before you reveal it". Three numbered questions with spacious empty ruled answer areas:
1. What is the paragraph mainly about?
2. What example supports that point?
3. How does your explanation connect them?
Visual exercise: Four broad blank ruled writing areas labelled Point, Support, Explain, Link. Hand-drawn bracket links the four areas. Writing exercise, no single correct model paragraph.
At the bottom a separated pale answer panel below a dotted horizontal divider. Exact panel header: "Cover before answering". Answers numbered to match:
1. State one clear main idea.
2. Choose a relevant example or evidence.
3. Explain why the example supports the point.
invocation: Use $memory-drills to explain build a clear paragraph for a beginner. Include three retrieval questions, blank writing space and a covered answer panel. Use Ivory ruled paper, rose and amber accents, expressive brush heading, tidy handwritten body.
